Olga — putting initial answers here (will paste into the questionnaire spreadsheet and attach artifacts):

1) SSO (SAML & OIDC) - Redwood supports both SAML 2.0 (IdP-initiated and SP-initiated) and OIDC (authorization code flow with PKCE). We support custom attribute/claim mappings during SSO configuration; mapping transformations (rename, default value, regex) are available in the Console and via the Management API.

2) SCIM provisioning - We provide SCIM 2.0 endpoints for user and group provisioning. Multi-tenant behavior: each customer tenant is scoped to a unique SCIM base URL and token; cross-tenant provisioning is not permitted. SCIM supports: create, update (PATCH), bulk replace (PUT), and incremental delta queries (via lastModified filtering).

- Provisioning modes: "Create+Sync" (one-way from IdP to Redwood) and "Provision+Reconcile" (periodic reconciliation to correct drift).
- We include an example mapping file (scim_mapping.csv) showing attribute mappings from common IdPs to Redwood user fields (externalId, email, roleAssignment).
- Example payload snippet included as an attachment: scim_sample_payload.json (delta payload example).

3) RBAC and delegated admin model - Primary roles: Tenant Admin, Org Viewer, Billing Admin, Support Operator. Roles are hierarchical and can be scoped to tenant or organization level. Delegated admin: Tenant Admins can grant lower-scope roles (Org Viewer, Support Operator) to service accounts; Tenant Admin scope is restricted to their tenant only.

- Cross-tenant admin is only available through explicit, auditable support escalation handled via a documented process (requires owner consent + 2nd approver).
- Role change requests are audited and require an approval workflow for elevated scopes.

4) Audit logs & retention - All authz changes, provisioning events, SSO assertions and API provisioning calls are logged to our audit pipeline (immutable append-only log). Logs include timestamp, principal (user/service), action, target, and request id.

- Default retention: 90 days in hot storage; configurable up to 7 years in cold storage via Enterprise plan.
- Evidence: redwood-soc2-2027.pdf contains our logging and integrity controls; I'll attach a short extract focused on identity logs.

5) Administrative runbook (brief)
- I prepared a short runbook describing: initial provisioning, onboarding a new IdP, handling SCIM reconciliation failures, and the escalation path for cross-tenant admin requests. I'll attach admin-role-matrix.pdf and a runbook draft (BluePeak_runbook_draft.pdf).

Notes for packaging: keep the answers direct, reference the artifacts (mapping CSV, runbook PDF, SOC2 extract), and call out exact API endpoints and sample request IDs where helpful.

-- Karthik
Principal Applied Engineer, Redwood Inference

- SSO: Redwood supports SAML 2.0 (IdP/SP initiated) and OIDC with standard claim/attribute transformations. We include mapping controls in Console + Management API. 
- SCIM: SCIM 2.0 support with tenant-scoped base URLs and tokens; supports PATCH and delta syncs. Included scim_mapping.csv and a sample delta payload. 
- RBAC & Delegation: Tenant-scoped Tenant Admin role, lower-scope roles (Org Viewer, Support Operator), documented escalation path for cross-tenant admin with owner consent + 2nd approver. Attached admin-role-matrix.pdf and a short onboarding runbook draft. 
- Audit & Evidence: Audit pipeline logs all provisioning and admin actions (immutable), 90-day default retention (configurable to 7 years). Included redwood-soc2-2027.pdf extract and an anonymized sample audit record.

Attachments in the packet: BluePeak_Response_Packet.pdf (compiled answers + artifacts), scim_mapping.csv, admin-role-matrix.pdf, redwood-soc2-2027.pdf, anonymized-audit-record.txt. Packet is also available here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cBluePeakResponse
